item.title: Camí de Picasso
item.description:
“The only journey is the one within.” - Rainer Maria Rilke(?)

Last month, between the 2nd and 5th of September, I hiked a trail known as the Camí de Picasso in Catalonia, Spain, over four days. Since I am currently a bit too lazy to write about the trail, I am leaving a trail of photos instead.

Day 1 - Guardiola de Berguedà - Saldes

Distance: 21.1 km. Elevation: +1,016 / −541 m.
